raw_response:
I am old now, 74 years, and this small plot near my house has my enset and some fruit trees that my family planted long ago. I have no money for chemical fertilizer, and the cooperative fertilizer is for the grain plots anyway, not for enset. I spread the manure from our few animals around the enset stems like we always do, and my grandchildren help me weed and harvest when the time comes. I cannot afford to hire anyone, and these perennial plants do not need much — they have been growing for years already.
